MeManga 0.5.0 is a broad update to the desktop app and the command line. The library and Kindle delivery give you more control, `memanga watch` keeps scheduled checks running without cron, and new commands cover setup, diagnostics, backups and scripting.

Desktop downloads are attached to this release. This is also the first version for PyPI, as the `memanga` package: PyPI publishing follows this GitHub Release automatically.

[Documentation](https://meellm.github.io/MeManga/) · [Full changelog](https://github.com/meellm/MeManga/blob/v0.5.0/CHANGELOG.md)
